lines.t: He stepped down, word made flesh in the filth of the block
Man of sorrows, eyes on fire, time bomb clock
Friend of the broken, but the system marked him a threat
Priest plotting murder just to keep their respect
The adversary flashed the kingdom's neon on demand
He chose a splintered tree and a bloody soaked hand
Lamb led silent, no pack, no truce
World's guild hanging like a live wire noose
Two thousand years later, wolves flexing white suits
Prosperity in their teeth, poison in their roots
Sailing plastic heaven while the poor stay crushed
Stage lights thunder, but the spirit's been hurt
This ain't that soft fake messiah that your idols preach
This is yahoo, shu, a lion roaring out of reach
Terror of the wicked when the sky rips like a knife
Refuge for the broken who surrender their life
Let his name hit hard, 808's in your chest
Grace for the rebels but the weary find rest
No smoky filled myth where the tortured never tire
Just a second death in the lake of fire
They market a gospel with no awe, no fear
No judgment seat, no law drawn near
They cancel repentance, call rebellion grace
While the sheep starve thin with a smile on their face
They say, pray this once and you're set for good
But refuse to turn from what he said no man should
They trample his sacrifice, cheapen his blood
Building ivory towers that'll drown in the flood
The trumpet is green and the letters are red
The king stands ready with the crown in dread
He's coming with a sword that divides bone and soul
Either be made whole or be ripped from the roll
He's gonna grip the plate till the coastlines slide
Whole cities swallow when the sea runs high
Skylines tumble like chalk in his hand
Power grids die in the pride of the land
Hell mixed with fire, blood in the rain
Sirens and smoke in a furnace of pain
Pestilence in the water, famine in the streets
Concrete kingdoms buckling under his feet
Mother nation shaking, towers bent low
Streets split open where the rich once glowed
Mega church, marbles, stained glass, hopper
One quake, one plague, and your steeples all die
Nature turn enemy, winds like war
Rivers run red where the little ones poured
Every temple of idols, every tower of pride
One breath from his nostrils and they all capsized
This ain't that tame plastic savior they admire
This is Yahushua as a blazing fire
Graves for the body, then the cord
At the end either life in his kingdom or no breath again
Let his name shake
Puse, crack your desire
You're headed for rebellion, lake of fire for the liar
No halfway coven, no lukewarm choir
Be weed on his threshing floor, fuel for the pyre
Truth is day whom you serve, no spin
Cling to your idols or be crucified with them
Count the cost, drop your crown, let your ego die
Better lose your life now than be erased with a sigh
All your lust, all your pride, every hidden scheme
Burning now on the altar or be lost like a dream
Flesh to the dust and the bones to the ground
And the books get open when the king comes down
Yahushua HaMashiach, double-edged word
Every mask ripped off, every motive heard
No more stage, no more script, no more choir for hire
Just the holy one deciding who escapes the fire
This is the line in the sand, the dividing sword
No middle lane when you stand before the Lord
Either hidden in his wounds when the stars expire
Or a name never spoken from the lake of fire
We'll see you next time.
